import hashlib,json,difflib
C=Path("/home/ningyd/文档/ChatGPT/BIGsmall/artifacts/research/process/20261004-ced-development/astra-rounds/round250-p6-t2-new-run-provenance-correction-20261015")
def pin(p,b=None):
 b=p.read_bytes() if b is None else b
 return dict(path=str(p),bytes=len(b),sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest())
def put(p,b):
 with p.open('xb') as h:assert h.write(b)==len(b)
 assert p.read_bytes()==b
 return pin(p,b)
p=json.loads((C/'plan.json').read_bytes());before=C/'before/run-command.py';runner=Path(p['scope']['only_modified_existing']);candidate=Path(p['outputs']['candidate'])
old=before.read_bytes();new=runner.read_bytes()
assert pin(before)=={**p['scope']['before'],'path':str(before)}
assert old.count(p['scope']['exact_old'].encode())==1
assert new==old.replace(p['scope']['exact_old'].encode(),p['scope']['exact_new'].encode(),1)
assert pin(runner)==p['scope']['expected_after'] and candidate.read_bytes()==new
assert sum(a!=b for a,b in zip(old,new))==1 and len(old)==len(new)==47902
D=runner.parent.parent
fixture=Path("/home/ningyd/文档/ChatGPT/BIGsmall/tests/test_local_public_writer_binding_race.py");prepare=D/'implementation/prepare-evidence.py'
assert pin(fixture)['bytes']==16525 and pin(fixture)['sha256']=='106fdeaaa0ff47cb0584fa6f79e1a0e8afef82bc58622b618717cd88a6038e14'
assert pin(prepare)['bytes']==20072 and pin(prepare)['sha256']=='a491956973edba1bc808b9d5b8876933beaee2e2976e4932962b53a54d22cd0e'
roles=[]
for name in ['command-ledger.json','root-command-ledger.json']:
 q=D/name;v=json.loads(q.read_bytes())
 assert all(x['used']==0 and x['remaining']==1 and x['state']=='HELD' for x in v['commands'].values())
 roles.append(pin(q))
diff=''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old.decode().splitlines(keepends=True),new.decode().splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile=str(before),tofile=str(runner))).encode()
diff_pin=put(Path(p['outputs']['limited_diff']),diff)
receipt=Path(p['outputs']['native_receipt'])
report={'round':'R250','status':'SOURCE_CORRECTION_READY_PENDING_ROOT_GATE','runner_before':pin(before),'runner_after':pin(runner),
 'candidate':pin(candidate),'native_receipt':pin(receipt),'limited_diff':diff_pin,
 'actual_scope':{'occurrences':1,'differing_bytes':1,'bytes_before':47902,'bytes_after':47902,
 'old':p['scope']['exact_old'],'new':p['scope']['exact_new'],'all_other_runner_bytes_identical':True,'candidate_full_bytes_equal_after':True,'EOF_unchanged':old.endswith(b'\n')==new.endswith(b'\n')},
 'unchanged_fixture':pin(fixture),'unchanged_prepare':pin(prepare),'roles_HELD':roles,
 'historical_mapping':{'original':p['scope']['before'],'archive':pin(before),
 'boundary':'Only exact old logical7e66 identity maps to complete physical R250 before. Original R248 candidate/native/report remain frozen old-generation records.'},
 'source_preparation_only':True,'source_execution':False,'new_execution_slots':0,'old_slots_reset':False,'legal_RED':False,'T2_complete':False,'T12_complete':False,
 'next':'STOP for ROOT independent exact native reconstruction/source gate; no baseline/Ruff/RED authority.'}
report_pin=put(Path(p['outputs']['change_report']),(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
print(json.dumps({'report':report_pin,'runner_before':report['runner_before'],'runner_after':report['runner_after'],
 'candidate':report['candidate'],'native_receipt':report['native_receipt'],'limited_diff':diff_pin,'new_execution_count':0},ensure_ascii=False))
